name: add_right_cancel'
statement: lemma add_right_cancel' {x y n : ℕ} : x + n = y + n → x = y
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | BaseCase =>
    intro h
    calc
      x = x + 0 := by apply_def add
      _ = y + 0 := by rel [h]
      _ = y     := by apply_def add
  | InductiveStep k IH =>
    intro h1
    have h2 :=
      calc
        succ (x + k) = x + succ k   := by apply_def add
        _            = y + succ k   := by rel [h1]
        _            = succ (y + k) := by apply_def add
    apply succ_inj at h2
    exact IH h2

name: succ_inj
statement: theorem succ_inj {a b : ℕ} (h : succ a = succ b) : a = b

name: zero_or_succ
statement:
theorem zero_or_succ : ∀ x : ℕ, x = 0 ∨ ∃ n, x = succ n
  | 0 => by left; rfl
  | succ n => by right; use n

name: eq_succ_of_ne_zero
statement: theorem eq_succ_of_ne_zero {x : ℕ} (hx : x ≠ 0) : ∃ n, x = succ n

name: lt_succ
statement: theorem lt_succ (x : ℕ) : x < succ x

name: le_of_lt
statement: theorem le_of_lt {x y : ℕ} (h : x < y) : x ≤ y

name: le_of_eq
statement: theorem le_of_eq {x y : ℕ} (h : x = y) : x ≤ y

name: lt_or_eq_of_le
statement: theorem lt_or_eq_of_le {x y : ℕ} (h : x ≤ y) : x < y ∨ x = y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := h
  obtain rfl | ⟨m, rfl⟩ := zero_or_succ n
  · right
    rfl
  · left
    use m
    rw [succ_add]
    rfl

name: not_lt_self
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
  have H :=
    calc
      succ n + x = x + succ n := add_comm ..
      _ = succ (x + n) := rfl
      _ = succ x + n := by rw [succ_add]
      _ = x := hn.symm
  exact zero_ne_succ _ (add_left_eq_self H).symm

name: not_lt_and_eq
statement: theorem not_lt_and_eq (x y : ℕ) : ¬ (x < y ∧ x = y)
proof:
:=
  fun h ↦ not_lt_self y <| h.2 ▸ h.1

name: premultiplication_wd
add_i
statement: lemma add_i (a b : ℕ) : i (a + b) = i a + i b
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [i]
  apply Quotient.sound
  dsimp [preaddition]
  rfl

name: mul_i
statement: lemma mul_i (a b : ℕ) : i (a * b) = i a * i b
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [i]
  apply Quotient.sound
  dsimp [premultiplication]
  rw [zero_mul, zero_add]
  rfl

name: exists_eq_or_eq_neg
statement: lemma exists_eq_or_eq_neg (x : ℤ) : (∃ n, x = i n) ∨ (∃ n, x = - i n)
proof:
:= by
  We represent x as (a, b)
  obtain h1 | h2 := le_total a b
  · obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, b = a + k := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le h1
    right
    use k
    apply Quotient.sound
    show _ = _
    dsimp
  · obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, a = b + k := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le h2
    left
    use k
    apply Quotient.sound
    show _ = _
    dsimp

name: dvd_iff_dvd
statement: lemma dvd_iff_dvd (a b : ℕ) : (∃ k, b = a * k) ↔ (∃ k, i b = i a * k)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨k, rfl⟩
    use i k
    exact mul_i a k
  · intro ⟨k, hk⟩
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ | ⟨k, rfl⟩ := exists_eq_or_eq_neg k
    · use k
      rw [← mul_i] at hk
      apply injective_i
      exact hk
    · have : i b + i a * i k = 0 := by
        rw [mul_comm, ← neg_mul] at hk
        rw [hk, mul_comm, neg_add_cancel]
      rw [← mul_i, ← add_i] at this
      change _ = i 0 at this
      apply injective_i at this
      obtain rfl : b = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_add_eq_zero_right this
      use 0
      ring

name: MyNat.equivalence
statement:
theorem MyNat.equivalence : Equivalence (α := ℕ × ℕ) (fun (a, b) (c, d) ↦ a + d = b + c) where
  /- reflexivity -/
  refl
proof:
:= by
    intro (a, b)
    dsimp
    ring
  /- symmetry -/
  symm := by
    intro (a, b) (c, d) h
    dsimp at h ⊢
    calc c + b = b + c := by ring
      _ = a + d := by rw [h]
      _ = d + a := by ring
  /- transitivity -/
  trans := by
    intro (a, b) (c, d) (e, f) h1 h2
    dsimp at h1 h2 ⊢
    have :=
    calc
      (a + f) + d = a + d + f := by ring
      _ = b + c + f := by rw [h1]
      _ = b + (c + f) := by ring
      _ = b + (d + e) := by rw [h2]
      _ = (b + e) + d := by ring
    apply add_right_cancel at this
    exact this

name: injective_i
proof:
:= by
  intro x y h1
  have h2 := Quotient.exact h1
  change x + 0 = 0 + y at h2
  convert h2 <;> ring
